categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies chain sync eviction logic in src/net_processing.cpp and adds a P2P functional test
categories.rationale: Prevents nodes on slow or high-latency networks like Tor or I2P from becoming stuck in an eviction loop during headers presync. The PR description notes that ~480 round trips on mainnet can exceed the 22-minute eviction timeout, causing the node to repeatedly disconnect the sync peer and discard all presync progress.
